# NullTracer auto-generated SENTINEL query
# Chain ID: chain_001

DeviceProcessEvents
| where (FolderPath endswith @"\powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "-enc")
    or (FolderPath endswith @"\rundll32.exe")
    or (FolderPath endswith @"\wmiprvse.exe")
| summarize Events=count(), Processes=make_set(FolderPath) by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessId, Timestamp
| where array_length(Processes) >= 3
